  RootPackage
  class GenericError<T>() : Exception(<1 args>)
  fun failInt()
    throw
      Call GenericError<Int>
  fun failString()
    throw
      Call GenericError<String>
  fun main()
    try
      Call failInt
    catch error: GenericError<Int>
      Call println
        StringLiteral "int"
    try
      Call failString
    catch error: GenericError<Int>
      Call println
        StringLiteral "wrong"
    catch error: Exception
      Call println
        StringLiteral "base"
